title: New tall white arrivals come too close at Range Three
summary: Charles Hall tells of New tall white arrivals come too close at Range Three, about 1965 at Range Three, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Range Three, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: One night I was out in range three and a group of new arrivals, it was after the full moon, a week or so,

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white beings while serving at an air force range in Nevada, tells of a night in 1965 at a spot called Range Three in Indian Springs Valley. He says that about a week after the full moon a group of newly arrived tall whites came too close to him. If true, it would mean the military was quietly sharing ground with visitors from elsewhere.
